description: Exact one-slack Pi0 bridge reduction and exhaustive elimination of the 29-edge extremal remainder layer.
scope_note: Covers the theoretical reduction of every 20-vertex Pi0 bridge to a 19-vertex remainder with 28 or 29 edges, and all 304 graphs in the complete 29-edge extremal layer. The 28-edge near-extremal layer is not completed, so this is not a 20-vertex bridge census or an order-38 result. No proof-assistant formalization exists.
